expressions.en: To innovate / To generate new ideas

expressions.bm_casual: Buat benda baru / Ada idea baru

expressions.cn: 优化 / 提高效率 (yōuhuà / tígāo xiàolǜ)
数字化 / 走向数字化 (shùzìhuà / zǒuxiàng shùzìhuà)
解决问题 / 解决难题 (jiějué wèntí / jiějué nántí)
数据分析 / 分析数据 (shùjù fēnxī / fēnxī shùjù)
用户友好 / 易于使用 (yònghù yǒuhǎo / yìyú shǐyòng)

work.scenario: Our team is tasked with improving productivity. We need to **menginovasi** our current workflow and **mendigitalkan** more processes to **meningkatkan kecekapan** overall.

life.scenario: I'm trying to **menyelesaikan masalah** with my smart home device. It's not very **mesra pengguna**. Maybe I need to find a way to **mengoptimumkan** its settings.

tech.scenario: The new software update aims to **mengoptimumkan** data processing. We're also implementing a new feature for **analisis data** to help users **mencetuskan idea baharu** based on insights.
